careTypes.title: Residential care
careTypes.copy: Comfortable, long-term care with round-the-clock support — and as much independence as each resident wants to keep.

careTypes.title: Dementia care
careTypes.copy: A calm, familiar environment with a specialist team, designed around each person's routines, history and family.

careTypes.title: Respite stays
careTypes.copy: Short stays from one week — for recovery after hospital, or to give a family carer a proper break.
